steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: I saw very clearly that you guys fought together. Well done, Chief, for gaining the trust of that diehard Iron.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: What have you learned about suspect R and the "inheritance" with her?

steps.speaker: Choice
steps.content: Iron agreed to leave her at my disposal.
options: Iron agreed to leave her at my disposal.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Really? Where is she now? Get her out, then we'll have accomplished our goal!

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Oh, and find a chance to lock up those two Sinners as well, then this will be the end of SALVA!

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Go, Chief. I'll create opportunities for you.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I have a question for you.

steps.content: About the young assassin girl, the Mania Crystal inside her, and everything.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: ...I see ...So someone is using her ...In this case, my speculation was right. She was sent by a <color=#fb9259>Sinner rebel group</color> to kill you.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Don't worry, Chief. She has already fled from me once. She won't dare to attack you again.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Whatever controls her is the same as the Mania Crystal your men uses.

steps.content: The fight, the assassin, and the fellow gangsters here to the rescue—They were all very timely.
Ted the sharpshooter fired seven shots at the girl, yet none of the shots were fatal.

Then the young girl stopped attacking you, not because she failed her mission and was abandoned. On the contrary, her mission was complete—She sacrificed herself so that her master could get close to you.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: ...Chief. The Public Security Bureau sent me here to assist you. Distrust will only divide the departments.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: So, intel about me was leaked from the Public Security Bureau.

steps.content: This is the last piece of the puzzle—the one who knows about this secret operation besides MBCC—is the Public Security Bureau.
And for a smart person like you, Ted, it won't be difficult to bribe one or two sheriffs, expand your network, and steal intel in a lawless place like Syndicate.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: ...What a shame. When I heard that the Bureau sent someone here, I only planned to lend a hand to get rid of those two SALVA troublemakers.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: What a surprise you are.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: You have such powerful shackles that even the Sinners obey you and their powers are at your disposal. You made me want a <color=#fb9259>companion</color> for the first time.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: If we work together, not only the inheritance—all the Sinners here and the entire Syndicate can be ours.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Haha... That's right. I sensed that we were very different people, so I had no choice but to have a backup plan.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, there's an ambush.
A bunch of gangsters slowly surround you from behind.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: By the way, Chief, I have a surprise for you too. I'm better at using people than you are. I make the most of each of my pawns.
He grins at you. You suddenly have a bad feeling about this.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: When she almost died, she had no choice but to crawl to the door of SALVA to seek help. Her master doesn't care if she dies.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: I've come up with many plans to take down the SALVA <color=#fb9259>basement</color>.

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.content: The Maniacs and that kid can't take any more of this. Let me send them to the <color=#fb9259>basement</color> for refuge.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: I know them. I know what SALVA wants and what they will do. I know it <color=#fb9259>all</color>, and it's disgusting!

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Wh...?! That Sinner came to SALVA on purpose?!

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Hehe... It's very costly to raise a dog and then destroy it just to earn your trust.
Boom—!! A violent shake comes from underground. She has taken action!

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: I'm very grateful, Chief. Thank you for wiping out so many SALVA fighters and giving us more time.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: It'd be too late even for the diehard Iron to escape now. It'd be fantastic if she's already dead.
Ted turns to enter the hospital. You want to chase him, only to be blocked by the elite gangsters.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Back off! These guys all have Mania!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: For the sake of power, you even get your men infected by Mania?!

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: That's right. I've given everything for this day. There's no stopping me now.
